user.title: Fledge
user.description: Choose the Nest thermostat running Fledge. It has to be connected to Home Assistant over MQTT first.

confirm.title: Fledge
confirm.description: A Nest thermostat running Fledge was found (serial {serial}). Put Home Assistant on its screen?

cards.title: What the thermostat shows
cards.description: Each device is a card on the thermostat, in this order (drag to reorder). Turn the ring to browse them, press to open one: a light dims, a switch switches, a thermostat sets its temperature, a speaker its volume.

data_description.entities: Lights (a light group works for a whole room), switches, fans, other thermostats and media players.
data_description.wake: What shows when you walk up to it, turn the ring or press it while its screen is dark.
data_description.wake_device: Wake straight into one of the devices above instead.

abort.already_configured: This thermostat is already set up.
abort.no_thermostats: No Nest running Fledge was found. Connect it to Home Assistant over MQTT first.
abort.not_fledge: This isn't a thermostat running Fledge.

init.title: What the thermostat shows
init.description: Each device is a card on the thermostat, in this order (drag to reorder). Turn the ring to browse them, press to open one: a light dims, a switch switches, a thermostat sets its temperature, a speaker its volume.

data_description.entities: Lights (a light group works for a whole room), switches, fans, other thermostats and media players.
data_description.wake: What shows when you walk up to it, turn the ring or press it while its screen is dark.
data_description.wake_device: Wake straight into one of the devices above instead.

options.chooser: The device chooser: the thermostat among your devices, zoomed out
options.auto: Automatic: the speaker that's playing, else after sunset a light that's on, else the device chooser
options.thermostat: The thermostat, as the Nest always did

thermostat_outdated.title: Update the thermostat's Fledge
thermostat_outdated.description: The Nest thermostat {serial} runs a Fledge build older than this integration needs, so some of its cards may not work. Install its update from the thermostat's update entity (Settings → Updates).

notify.name: Notify on the thermostat
notify.description: Shows a notification on the Nest's screen, waking it, with a chime. A press answers it and a long press (or its time running out) dismisses it; either fires a fledge_notification event with its tag. Returns the tag.

title.name: Title
title.description: A heading above the message, or over the camera's picture.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Shown above the title when there's no picture.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: Shows this camera's picture, taken now, filling the screen: a doorbell's, say.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: How long it shows before it dismisses itself.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: Names it, for fledge.dismiss and in its event. Made up if left out.

dismiss.name: Dismiss on the thermostat
dismiss.description: Takes a notification off the Nest's screen.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: The tag it was shown with.
